title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For Hormonal Imbalance
intro: Herbal creams for hormonal imbalance are topical preparations made from a combination of herbs and natural ingredients that aim to restore balance to the body's hormonal system. These creams offer numerous benefits, including reducing symptoms of hormonal imbalance such as hot flashes, mood swings, and acne, as well as promoting relaxation and stress relief. Examples of herbal creams used to treat hormonal imbalance include Maca root cream, which helps regulate estrogen levels, and Wild yam cream, which reduces symptoms of menopause; Ashwagandha cream, which alleviates stress and anxiety; and Evening primrose oil cream, which reduces inflammation and promotes hormonal balance. Additionally, other herbal creams like Dong quai cream, Sage cream, and Black cohosh cream are also used to treat hormonal imbalance due to their ability to regulate menstrual cycles and alleviate symptoms of menopause.

preparations.preparation_desc: Lavandula angustifolia creams have been found to be effective in treating hormonal imbalance ailments due to their antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and calming properties. These properties help to soothe the nervous system, regulate hormonal fluctuations, and alleviate symptoms such as anxiety and mood swings. The bioactive constituents of Lavandula angustifolia, including linalool and linalyl acetate, have been shown to have a sedative effect on the body, reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The benefits of using Lavandula angustifolia creams to treat hormonal imbalance ailments include improved sleep quality, reduced stress levels, and a decrease in anxiety and mood swings.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Fitoterapia", Lavandula angustifolia creams for hormonal imbalance may be a promising candidate for the treatment of polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) as they effectively increased progesterone levels and regulated menstrual cycles in PCOS patients.

preparations.preparation_desc: Curcuma longa creams, derived from the turmeric plant, have been used to treat hormonal imbalance ailments due to their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to regulate the endocrine system and alleviate symptoms such as mood swings and acne. The bioactive constituents, including curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin, exhibit potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, thereby reducing inflammation and oxidative stress in the body. By inhibiting the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes and cytokines, Curcuma longa creams help to regulate hormonal balance and alleviate symptoms associated with hormonal imbalances. The benefits of using Curcuma longa creams to treat hormonal imbalance ailments include reduced inflammation, improved mood, and enhanced overall well-being.

Avena sativa creams are a herbal preparation derived from the oat plant, used to treat hormonal imbalance ailments such as menopause and polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS). The bioactive constituents in Avena sativa creams, including avenacoside and avenasterol, help to regulate the body's hormonal balance by modulating the activity of enzymes and hormones. Regular use of Avena sativa creams has been shown to provide benefits such as reduced hot flashes, improved sleep quality, and a decrease in stress and anxiety levels associated with hormonal imbalances.

preparations.preparation_study: According to "Electronic physician", Melissa officinalis creams for hormonal imbalance may be effective in treating hot flashes and other symptoms of acute menopausal syndrome, as it is listed as one of the medicinal plants that were effective in the treatment of menopausal symptoms.

preparations.preparation_desc: Silybum marianum creams, derived from the milk thistle plant, are a natural herbal preparation used to treat hormonal imbalance ailments, particularly those associated with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS). The bioactive constituents of silymarin, including flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, have been found to help regulate hormone levels and improve insulin sensitivity, thereby alleviating symptoms of hormonal imbalances. Silybum marianum creams work by inhibiting the production of androgens, such as testosterone, and promoting the activity of antioxidants, which helps to mitigate oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The benefits of using Silybum marianum creams to treat hormonal imbalance ailments include improved menstrual regularity, reduced acne and hirsutism, and enhanced overall reproductive health.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Phytotherapy research : PTR", Silybum marianum creams for hormonal imbalance may be a helpful option for women experiencing hot flashes, as the study found that the herb significantly decreased the frequency and severity of hot flashes in women with menopausal symptoms.

The benefits of using Cimicifuga racemosa creams include relief from hot flashes, improved sleep quality, and a reduction in the risk of osteoporosis, making it a popular natural remedy for menopausal women.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "The journal of sexual medicine", Cimicifuga racemosa creams for hormonal imbalance may be useful in improving several symptoms of Female Sexual Dysfunction (FSD), particularly in climacteric women.
